outcome: fetal outcome (live fetus at scanning vs. IUD fetus at scanning)
cohort: The participants were 58 fetuses/pregnancies identified with congenital anomalies during the second and third trimesters.
finding: Out of 58 patients, 38 were males and 20 females, with live fetuses observed in 23 cases and IUD fetuses in 35 cases; common anomalies included anencephaly (14 cases) and cleft lip and palate (10 cases).
